The Company will consider repurchasing MSTR when management believes it is trading below intrinsic value, which would be accretive to common shareholders. ▪ BTC Monetization Program: The Company has board authorization to sell bitcoin to: ▪ Fund the USD Reserve up to $1.25 billion of bitcoin
